assumptions.estimand: Recovery conditional on the specified original-failure cohort, not ordinary-stream accuracy or a training gain.
assumptions.failure_cohort: Condition on valid-schema original value failures, defined before any intervention outcomes are inspected. The target count may drive original-case accrual only; it may not be changed based on the repair-versus-retry difference.
assumptions.generator_scope: Power is nominal conditional on independent case pairs from this fixed generator. The current six scenario variants share one generator program; they are not six independent template programs.
assumptions.no_adjustment_for_clustering: Power is exact only for independent case pairs from the fixed generator. The six current scenario variants share one generator program and do not provide six independent program clusters. Family-stratified descriptive results can be reported, but broader-template validation is future work, not implemented here.

main_preregistration.cluster_sensitivity: The six scenario variants share one generator program. Report family-stratified results descriptively; they do not estimate between-program variation. Broader-template validation is future work, not implemented. The exact McNemar power grid is nominal conditional on independent case pairs from this fixed generator.
main_preregistration.confidence_interval: report paired case-level percentile bootstrap 95% interval for the recovery difference; resample whole paired cases, 20,000 replicates, fixed seed 246600; report interval regardless of primary test result
main_preregistration.eligibility: schema-valid original answer with at least one incorrect typed value; citation-only, schema, transport, and unusable responses are excluded from the eligible failure cohort
main_preregistration.paired_arms: one fresh retry and one feedback-repair request per selected case; same original source and verifier; repair package contains the original output plus generic verified failed-field labels, but no gold value or calculation trace
main_preregistration.primary_effect: paired recovery difference = repair success proportion minus fresh-retry success proportion among selected original failures
main_preregistration.primary_outcome: valid schema and all seven exact typed values
main_preregistration.primary_success_criterion: positive paired recovery difference AND two-sided exact conditional McNemar p < 0.05
main_preregistration.prior_data: All v1, hard-v2, v3, and v4 results are excluded from scale-up inferential analysis; v4 is used only as a planning reference.
main_preregistration.request_count_arithmetic: 2,048 original + 96 audit + 32 pilot + 2*600 intervention requests; this counts planned CLI requests, not internal subprocess retries
main_preregistration.secondary_outcome: full acceptance including evidence citations; report separately and do not replace primary outcome
main_preregistration.seed_policy: Record source-generation, case-ranking, and bootstrap seeds in the frozen protocol before any scale-up model call; bootstrap seed is fixed here as 246600.
main_preregistration.selection: After each original tranche, identify only eligible cases by the frozen value-failure rule. At the stop, freeze exactly 600 eligible case IDs if at least 600 are available; if fewer, freeze all available. If a tranche produces more eligible cases than needed, choose with the recorded predeclared seeded ranking, independent of error magnitude and intervention outcomes. All IDs and semantic source records must be new and non-overlapping with v1, hard-v2, v3, and v4 corpora, using compatible semantic comparisons where possible.
main_preregistration.stopping_and_peeking: no interim intervention-outcome inspection or efficacy stopping; original accrual may stop only when 600 eligible failures are frozen or 2,048 originals are exhausted; the 96-case audit and up-to-32 pilot are separate and excluded from paired efficacy inference

planning_reference_v4.note: Planning reference only; these estimates are noisy and conditional on v4's selected failure cohort.

purpose: Prospective planning for a paired repair-package versus fresh-retry comparison; no model calls or study data changes.

randomness.future_cohort_seed: Predeclare and record separate seeds for source generation and the failure-case ranking before calls; do not select by intervention outcomes or error magnitude.
randomness.power_calculation: Deterministic exact enumeration; no simulation is used and no random seed applies to power values.

recommendation.accrual_rule: Adopted protocol: accrue original cases in an initial 512-case tranche, then fixed 256-case tranches up to a hard cap of 2,048 originals. Stop accrual only when 600 eligible original failures are frozen or the cap is reached. Eligibility is a schema-valid original answer with at least one wrong value. If the cap yields fewer than 600 failures, run the paired comparison on the attained cohort and report it as underpowered/inconclusive; never extend based on intervention outcomes. The 3,600-case value is retained only as a sizing scenario, not the adopted cap.
recommendation.arms: Each selected original failure receives one fresh retry and one repair-package attempt; the latter receives the exact old answer plus generic verified failed-field flags. This estimates the package versus another attempt, not the isolated effect of feedback.
recommendation.cost_note: The planned cohort implies 1,200 intervention item attempts, plus original-case accrual and audit calls. Actual CLI calls, tokens, and elapsed time depend on batching and must be reported; USD cost is unknown unless the CLI supplies a defensible charge.
recommendation.new_case_id_requirement: All selected scale-up case IDs must be new and non-overlapping with v1, hard-v2, v3, and v4 source/pilot corpora; compare semantic hashes where representations support a compatible comparison.
recommendation.reason: 600 is the first requested cohort size with at least 90% power for the preregistered positive-difference plus two-sided exact-test criterion at all three requested discordance rates. A smaller realized difference can still be inconclusive.

software.calculation: For K discordant pairs, X repair-only wins is Binomial(K, (D+delta)/(2D)); K is Binomial(N,D). The primary probability sums only the repair-favoring tail that also passes the two-sided exact McNemar boundary; the optional any-direction probability sums both tails.

test.alternative: repair-only success probability minus fresh-only success probability equals the listed true difference
test.discordance: probability that exactly one of the paired arms succeeds
test.name: two-sided exact conditional McNemar test
test.paired_unit: one distinct eligible original-failure source case, sent to both arms
test.primary_outcome: all seven values correct with valid schema; citation acceptance is secondary
